content: Alertmanager cluster mode (prometheus.io HA docs + repo design doc): gossip on TCP port 9094 replicates silences and notification log to all peers (full replication; the --cluster.replication-factor flag was removed around v0.16 when memberlist/SWIM gossip was adopted); LWW by timestamp on state updates - explicitly availability over consistency; mutual TLS with client cert auth for cluster traffic (--cluster.tls-config); external_labels must be identical across replicas to avoid dedup problems.
